title: Create: Celestial Mechanics
description: Launch yourself into space with the Create mod!
body: --- ![f](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b87bfa39e2f6c5dd78d11d6c5728ef7021c7d6c.png) > ⚠️ **Note-1**: This modpack is still in heavy development. Majority of the features are not implemented yet, feedback is highly appreciated. > ![f](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b87bfa39e2f6c5dd78d11d6c5728ef7021c7d6c.png) > *Launch yourself into space with the Create mod!* Embark on an epic journey from humble workshops to interplanetary exploration! **Create: Celestial Mechanics** is a modpack that combines the mechanical ingenuity of **Create** with the thrill of space adventure. --- ## ✨ Key Features 🔧 **Integrated Progression System** Start with basic contraptions and work your way up to building rockets, space stations, and interplanetary logistics—all seamlessly connected through a custom questline. 🌱 **Refined Early Game** Thanks to **Rough Beginnings**, your journey begins with a slightly tweaked progression—more challenging, more rewarding, and perfectly balanced to ease you into the modpack's mechanics. 🌌 **Space Exploration** Blast off with **???** to explore new planets, mine asteroids, and establish off-world bases. 🏭 **Deep Create Integration** Every mod in this pack is designed to work together. Power your factory with **Create: Electro Energetics**, automate metal processing with **Create: Metallurgy**, and explore new structures with **Integrated MC**. 📜 **Guided Quests** A comprehensive quest system guides you through the modpack, introducing mechanics gradually while rewarding creativity and experimentation. 🌿 **Enhanced Immersion** Uncover mysteries of the overworld with **No Man's Land**, enjoy beautiful seasons with **Serene Seasons**, cook delicious meals with **Farmer's Delight**, and decorate your bases with **Quark**, **Supplementaries**, and **Architect's Palette**. --- ## 🧰 Featured Mods ### Core Experience - **Create** – The foundation of mechanical automation - **???** – Space travel and planets exploration - **Create: Aeronautics** – Advanced flight and airship engineering - **No Man's Land** – Challenging new overworld to conquer - **Create: Metallurgy** – Industrial processing and metallurgy ### Quality of Life & Content - Quark • Supplementaries • Vista • Create: Electro Energetics • Integrated MC Series • Serene Seasons • Farmer's Delight • Rough Beginnings • *...and many more!* --- ## 🎮 Getting Started 1. Install the modpack 2. Open the quest book (default key: `~`) to begin your journey 3. Build, automate, and launch — your cosmic adventure awaits! > 💡 *Tip: Follow the quests in order for the smoothest progression experience. Rough Beginnings modifies initial resource availability, so read quest hints carefully!* --- ## 🙏 Credits & Inspiration - **Inspired by**: [Create: Astral](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/create-astral) – A huge thank you to the team for pioneering Create-based space exploration! - **Modpack Author**: `over144000` - **All mod authors** – This pack wouldn't exist without your incredible work. --- ## 💬 Community & Support 🔗 **Join our Discord**: https://discord.gg/JSVNarqe - Get help with quests or technical issues - Share your creations and contraptions - Suggest improvements and vote on future updates - Connect with fellow engineers and space explorers! --- > ⚠️ **Note-2**: This is a medium-to-heavy modpack. Recommended to allocate 8GB RAM and higher for optimal performance. --- *Build. Launch. Explore.* 🌠🔧🚀
